- Overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast highs.
- Underestimate downward trends; model tends to lag in recognizing sharp declines.
- Overshoot after sharp upward moves; cap forecast peaks to avoid overreaction.
- Exhibit mean reversion bias: model often overcorrects after strong moves, then undercorrects.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent bias toward higher values in early days, then gradually converges — adjust for diminishing bias over time.
- Avoid extrapolating recent volatility into future; dampen forecast variance when history shows high noise.
